aboutUs.title: Salah Time gurinchi
aboutUs.subtitle: Sooryuni sthaanam aadhaaramga lekkinchabadina aidu rojuvaari Salah samayaala kosam visual guide.
aboutUs.description: Salah Time mee sthaanam, teedi mariyu sooryuni sthaanam aadhaaramga khachchitamaina khagola paddhatulanu upayogimchi motham aidu rojuvaari Salah samayaalanu ganistundi:
aboutUs.fajr: Horizon lo modati kaanti kanipinchinappudu telavaarujaamuna praarambhamavutundi, horizon krinda sooryuni yokka nirdishta konaanni upayogimchi lekkinchabadutundi.
aboutUs.dhuhr: Sooryudu aakaashamlo ettaina pradeshaaniki cherukunnappudu (saura madhyaahnam) praarambhamavutundi.
aboutUs.asr: Enchukunna Madhab (Hanafi leda pramaanam) aadhaaramga oka vastuvu yokka needa daani podavuku samaanamga leda rendu rettu maarinappudu praarambhamavutundi.
aboutUs.maghrib: Sooryudu horizon diguvana astamimchina ventane praarambhamavutundi, sandhyaa kaalaala kosam aichchika chinna podigimputo.
aboutUs.isha: Raatri purtigaa praarambhamainappudu praarambhamavutundi, Maghrib tarvaata nirneeta samayamto leda horizon krinda sooryuni konam aadhaaramga lekkinchabadutundi.
aboutUs.footer: Sthaanika samaaveshaalu leda vyaktigata praadhaanyatala kosam prati Salah kosam adanapu sardubaatlu darakhaastu chesukovachchu.

calc.TITLE: Mee Salah samayaalanu memu ela lekkistaamu
calc.INTRO: Prati samayam mee phone lone moodu vishayaala nundi lekkinchabadutundi: mee nagara nirdeshaankaalu, teedi mariyu sooryuni sthaanam. Mudrita timetable nundi edi kooda copy cheyabadadu, kaabatti e nagaraanikaina, e rojukaina, internet lekapoyina samayaalu andubaatulo untaayi.
calc.STEP_SUN: Prati teediki sooryudu uttaram leda dakshinam vaipu enta kadulutaado mariyu madhyaahnamlo vachche chinna rojuvaari maarpunu (kaala sameekaranam) memu lekkistaamu.
calc.STEP_NOON: Mee nagara rekhaamsham nundi sooryudu aakaashamlo atyanta ettulo unde kshanaanni kanugontaamu. Zuhr daani tarvaata konni nimishaalaku modalavutundi.
calc.STEP_ANGLES: Fajr mariyu Isha sooryudu kshitijaaniki oka nirdishta konam diguvana unde kshanaalu. Sooryodayam mariyu Maghrib sooryuni pai anchu kshitijaanni daatite samayaalu, gaalilo kaanti vangadaanni lekkaloki teesukuni. Asr ni needa podavuto kolustaaru.
calc.METHODS_INTRO: Panditulu mariyu Islamic samsthalu Fajr, Isha ku ververe soorya konaalanu upayogistaaru. Mee sthaanika Masjid anusarinche paddhatini enchukondi.
calc.ANGLE_NOTE: Konaalu kshitijam diguvana sooryuni degrees. Pedda konam ante Fajr munduga, Isha aalasyamga.
calc.ASR_HANAFI: Hanafi: oka vastuvu needa daani podavuku rettimpu ainappudu, madhyaahna needato kalipi, Asr modalavutundi.
calc.ASR_SHAFII: Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali: oka vastuvu needa daani podavuku samaanamainappudu, madhyaahna needato kalipi, Asr modalavutundi.
calc.LIVE_DAILY: Prati teediki malli lekkinchabadutundi, kaabatti samayaalu rojuroojuku rutuvulanu anusaristaayi.
calc.LIVE_CHANGES: Meeru nagaram, paddhati, Madhab leda sardubaatlanu maarchina ventane naveekarinchabadutundi.
calc.LIVE_COUNTDOWN: Prastuta Namaz mariyu daani countdown prati sekanuku naveekarinchabadataayi.
calc.LIVE_LOCATION: Prastuta Location on lo unte, app terichina pratisaari mee nagaram naveekarinchabadutundi, kaabatti prayaanamlonoo samayaalu meeto untaayi.
calc.LIVE_TIMEZONE: Samayaalu enchukunna nagara sthaanika samayamlo, daylight saving tho saha choopabadataayi.
calc.LIVE_HIJRI: Hijri teedi mee deshapu chandra darshana prakatanalanu anusaristundi, maa brundam naveekaristundi.
calc.ACCURACY: Oke paddhatiki, lekkinchina samayaalu saadhaaranamga prachurinchina timetable lato konni nimishaallo saripolutaayi. Chaala Masjid lu jaagrattha kosam konni nimishaalu kaluputaayi; meedi bhinnamga unte, Settings loni Salah sardubaatlanu upayogimchandi.
